plugins.name: vibesku-clips
plugins.description: AI short-video production: a topic or product link becomes a finished vertical video (script → free stock footage → free TTS → captions → BGM → FFmpeg compose), keyless by default. Installs the vibesku-clips-video skill plus the VibeSKU Clips MCP server (vibesku_clips_create_video, vibesku_clips_product_script, vibesku_clips_gate …) targeting your local VibeSKU Clips instance. 一句话/商品链接直接出带货短视频。
